title: The New Tool-Room Sign-Out
text:
Starting October 6, the maintenance department will use a digital sign-out station for shared tools. Employees who have completed tool-safety training may check out standard hand tools and cordless drills without advance approval. Three specialized tools—the thermal camera, cable locator, and hydraulic crimper—still require a supervisor's approval before removal from the tool room.

Employees who need to keep any tool overnight must enter an overnight note before 3:00 p.m. The note must name the tool and the job site. If a tool is damaged, the employee should not return it to the normal shelf. Instead, the tool goes in the red inspection bin, and the employee completes a damage report before the end of the shift.

The paper sign-out log has not been eliminated entirely. Staff should use it only when the digital station is unavailable because of a system or network outage. When the station is working again, the tool-room coordinator will transfer the paper entries into the digital record. The department will review the new procedure after six weeks to see whether missing-tool reports have decreased.
author: Chee Skool
